{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ily57r",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 is defined as a PLC low-pressure input active below 4.5 bar (claim-nhxx37). The pressure at P-R dropped to values well below this threshold between 10:00 and 10:06, which would reliably trigger the alarm.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R had remained above 4.5 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; the pressure drop is a sufficient physical cause for the alarm state given the defined threshold.",
      "evidenceGap": ""
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-baeffs",
      "toKey": "n-1ihsteu",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 triggered at 10:03, which is after the initial pressure drop observed in P-R samples starting around 10:00. The event sequence shows a deviation from normal operation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the alarm had not triggered, it would imply either no pressure drop or a failure of the PLC input.",
      "competingExplanation": "The 'COMP FAULT' label is misleading; finding-11cpm89 supports that AL-44 maps to P-R low-pressure condition, not compressor status. The alarm indicates an interruption in supply reaching RHOB.",
      "evidenceGap": ""
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-x2152q",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The incident description states the interruption began at an unknown point (upstream, downstream, or within distribution). The pressure drop in P-R indicates that whatever caused the loss of supply propagated to RHOB.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": ["incident-description#structuredIncident.summary"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the interruption had occurred downstream at C-11, P-R might have shown a different pattern or no drop if upstream supply remained.",
      "competingExplanation": "The exact origin is unknown (n-e9h80u), but the effect on RHOB was real. The cause of the pressure loss remains an open question requiring further evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to determine whether the interruption originated at source, distribution system, or receiving equipment."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-13979pa",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work package cover indicates the temporary instruction attachment field was blank (n-kv06wr, n-nrva0b). If a service-routing change occurred without documentation or an approved temporary instruction attached to ECP revisions, this could explain why P-R pressure dropped unexpectedly.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a valid temporary instruction had been attached and the change was properly communicated, P-R pressure should have remained stable or followed expected patterns.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption could also be due to external factors (third-party work, utility outage) as noted in n-1st54eg. The blank attachment field alone does not prove a routing error without evidence of an unrecorded change.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to verify whether any service-routing changes occurred between 2024-03-01 and May 20, 2024 affecting RHOB instrument-air supply."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-zwzrhw",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Field valves may have been open contrary to procedure or an unrecorded service-routing change occurred. If field valves were inadvertently opened during boundary preparation, this could explain the pressure drop.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If field valves were closed as per procedure, the pressure drop would need another explanation.",
      "competingExplanation": "The area directory does not establish valve positions (n-x3ngwa). Without a current piping diagram or live valve-state record, this remains speculative.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to obtain field operation logs or witness statements confirming whether valves were manipulated during boundary preparation."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1st54eg",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "External factors such as third-party work or utility outage could have caused the pressure drop. If an external factor interrupted supply, this would explain the event without internal procedural failure.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no external factors were present, the cause must be internal (e.g., valve error, routing change).",
      "competingExplanation": "The incident description does not rule out external causes. Evidence is needed to confirm or exclude third-party work or utility outage.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to check with utilities provider and review maintenance logs for any scheduled or unscheduled activities affecting instrument-air supply."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The alarm AL-44 triggered due to a pressure drop at P-R, which was caused by an interruption in the instrument-air supply. The exact origin of this interruption remains unknown (upstream source, distribution system error, or external factor). Contributing factors may include unrecorded service-routing changes, field valve mismanagement during boundary preparation, or lack of documented temporary instructions for recent modifications.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1",
      "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1",
      "incident-description"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Exact origin of pressure drop (source vs. distribution system)",
      "Whether field valves were manipulated during boundary preparation",
      "Existence of unrecorded service-routing changes or temporary instructions"
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "External utility outage caused the interruption.",
      "Third-party work affected supply without notification."
    ],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": []
}
